videos.caption: the only way my SPF doesn't turn my cheeks into sandpaper #sunscreen #dryskin #skincarehack

transcript.text: Okay so every sunscreen I own dries my cheeks out by about lunchtime.
So what I do now is mix a drop of my moisturiser into the sunscreen in my palm.

I know it probably dilutes the SPF. I just haven't found one that does both.

videos.caption: Why your sunscreen feels drying (and what people are doing about it) #spf #skinscience

transcript.text: A lot of you asked why chemical sunscreens can feel drying on already dry skin.
Part of it is the alcohol and the film formers that help it set and stay put.
I keep seeing people layer a rich moisturiser and wait ten minutes, or even mix them together.
Honestly I'd love a high SPF that's formulated to be the moisturiser too, so nobody has to do that.
